supported_features: elongated dark sclerotial structures projecting from individual grains
hard smooth surface consistent with sclerotium
dark grey/black coloration of abnormal structures

contradictory_features: absence of leaf lesions typical of rust
absence of discrete flat necrotic leaf spots

diagnostic_bottleneck: uncertain whether honeydew exudate is present (early vs. late ergot stage)

final_decision.reason: The panicle shows scattered, elongated dark sclerotial bodies replacing grains, matching the hallmark elongated sclerotium of Pearl Millet Ergot; leaf‑based diseases and smut‑type ball structures are absent.

plant_part.specifics: Cylindrical panicle head with visible spikelets and grains

symptom_class.description: Discrete, dark, elongated structures replacing or emerging from individual florets/grains

geometry.orientation: projecting outward from the panicle surface
geometry.size_relative: Approximately 1.5x to 2x the length of adjacent normal grains
geometry.width_relative: Similar width to adjacent normal grains

surface.features: No visible powdery spores, no visible honeydew, no visible ruptured membranes

distribution.pattern: Scattered throughout the visible panicle length

spatial_location.position: On the surface of the panicle head
spatial_location.specifics: Emerging from the positions of individual grains

reproductive_structure.details: Individual grains are replaced by or accompanied by dark elongated bodies

developmental_stage.details: Grains appear fully formed prior to or during the emergence of the abnormal structures

present: Elongated dark structures projecting from florets
Structures occupying the position of normal grains
Dark grey/black coloration of abnormal structures
Pale cream coloration of normal grains
uncertain: Internal structure of the dark bodies (sclerotium vs. other)
Whether the dark bodies are fully replacing the grain or emerging from it
not_visible: Leaves (to check for downy mildew chlorosis)

evidence_quality.overall: High - Clear macroscopic view of the panicle and specific morphological changes
limiting_features: Lack of leaf visibility prevents ruling out systemic issues like Downy Mildew based on vegetative symptoms
No microscopic view to confirm sclerotium identity
